name: browser-use
headline: X Article Publisher - Publish Markdown to X
short_description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles with one command. Eliminates manual rich text editing. Supports dividers, tables, Mermaid diagrams, and cross-platform clipboard. Ideal for content teams and social media managers.
author: wshuyi

sections.overview:
x-article-publisher-skill automates the conversion of Markdown files into formatted X (Twitter) Articles, eliminating manual rich text editing. The skill detects and converts Markdown elements including dividers, tables (rendered as images), and Mermaid diagrams into X Article-compatible formats. It uses a clipboard-based workflow for efficient content transfer and supports YAML frontmatter in Markdown files. Cross-platform clipboard support works on Windows and macOS. This tool is designed for content teams, writers, and social media managers who need to publish formatted articles to X without manually recreating layout and styling.
Automate the publishing of Markdown articles to X Articles with a single command.
Efficiently manage and format multiple images within articles without manual positioning.
Convert Markdown tables into images for seamless integration into X Articles.
Utilize Mermaid diagrams in articles by converting them to PNG images automatically.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/wshuyi/x-article-publisher-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Publish this Markdown article to X (Twitter) Articles: [ARTICLE_MARKDOWN]. Include the following metadata: title '[TITLE]', description '[DESCRIPTION]', and tags '[TAGS]'. Ensure all formatting, including tables and Mermaid diagrams, is preserved. Use cross-platform clipboard for faster publishing.
```
Copy

```
Article published successfully to X (Twitter) Articles. Title: 'The Future of AI in Healthcare'. Description: 'Exploring how AI is transforming diagnostics, treatment, and patient care'. Tags: #AI #Healthcare #Innovation. Formatting preserved: 2 tables, 1 Mermaid diagram, and 3 dividers. Cross-platform clipboard used for faster publishing. Article URL: https://x.com/i/articles/123456789.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
